تستجلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَجْلُوا (tastajlū) /tas.tad͡ʒ.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# تُسْتَجْلَوْا (tustajlaw) /tus.tad͡ʒ.law/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
